instruction: `wrap` in `textutils/wrapping.py` breaks lines one character too early: a word that exactly fills the line is pushed to the next line. `wrap('aaa bb', 6)` produces two lines (`aaa` and `bb`) instead of keeping `aaa bb` on one line.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils/wrapping.py b/textutils/wrapping.py
--- a/textutils/wrapping.py
+++ b/textutils/wrapping.py
@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@
     lines = []
     current = words[0]
     for word in words[1:]:
-        if len(current) + 1 + len(word) < width:
+        if len(current) + 1 + len(word) <= width:
             current += " " + word
         else:
             lines.append(current)
